title: Austin's Major Gas Deal: Expert Hired
summary:
*   **Gas Contract Expert Hired:** The city employed a consulting engineer to advise on a significant new gas supply contract.
*   **Securing Best Gas Deal:** This expert will help draft contract specifications and evaluate bids to ensure the city obtains the best possible price and a reliable gas supply.
*   **Prominent Advisory Team:** A group of leading citizens, including a former University of Texas Chancellor and Supreme Court Justice, was appointed to assist in finalizing the contract.
transcript:
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
Special Meeting
February 24, 1960
10:00 Α.Μ.
Council Chamber, City Hall
The meeting was called to order with Mayor Miller presiding. Roll call: Present:
Councilmen Bechtol, Palmer, Perry, White, Mayor Miller Absent: None Present also: W. T.
Williams, Jr., City Manager; Doren R. Eskew, City Attorney Councilman Palmer moved that
the Council recess until 1:00 P.M. The motion, seconded by Councilman White, carried by
the following vote: Ayes: Councilmen Bechtol, Palmer, Perry, White, Mayor Miller Noes:
None
RECESSED MEETING
The Council resumed its meeting at 1:00 Ρ.Μ. 1:00 Ρ.Μ.
The Council interviewed MR. RALPH DAVIS, Consulting Engineer, with regard to his advising
in writing specifications for the proposed gas contract and evaluating the bids. Mr. Davis
listed his qualifications and experience and named some of the companies for which he had
made studies and had served as a consultant--COLUMBIA GAS COMPANY, CONSOLIDATED NATURAL
GAS COMPANY OF NEW YORK, UNION NATURAL GAS OF CANADA, AMERICAN NATURAL GAS COMPANY, a
holding company owning Michigan Gas Company, Michigan Pipe Line Company,
American-Louisiana Gas Company, Milwaukee Gas Company; NORTHERN NATURAL GAS COMPANY,
CANADIAN WESTERN NATURAL COMPANY, WEST COAST TRANSMISSION, UNITED GAS COMPANY, TENNESSEE
GAS COMPANY, SOUTHERN NATURAL GAS, TRANSCONTINENTAL GAS, TEXAS EASTERN, TEXAS GAS
TRANSMISSION, OKLAHOMA NATURAL GAS COMAPNY, and several others.
Bids had been advertised for March 9th, and Mr. Davis was asked if he could help draw up
the specifications, help to review the bids and make a recommendation in that length of
time. Mr. Davis reviewed some items to be considered in the specifications.
_ CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS...
The Council went into Executive Session. Councilman White moved that MR. RALPH DAVIS of
Houston be employed to check with the City in getting the specifications drawn; and after
the bids come in to check on all bids and most of all be fair to everybody and get the
very best price possible and plenty of gas.
The motion, seconded by Councilman Palmer, carried by the following vote: Ayes: Councilmen
Bechtol, Palmer, White, Mayor Miller Noes:
None
Present but not voting: Councilman Perry
MAYOR MILLER announced that the following had been appointed to assist in winding up the
contract; MR. CHARLES FRANCES, MR. JAMES P. HART, former Chancellor of the University of
Texas and Judge of the Supreme Court; and MR. COLEMAN GAY.
There being no further business, Councilman Bechtol moved that the Council adjourn. The
motion, seconded by Councilman Palmer, carried by the following vote: Ayes: Councilmen
Bechtol, Palmer, White, Mayor Miller Noes:
None
Present but not voting: Councilman Perry
The Council adjourned subject to the call of the Mayor. ATTEST:
City Clerk
APPROVED
Mayor
